tasks.short: Assess Noordhaven’s profit, cash and financial outlook across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.

today.trigger: Assumed current workflow: the nightly AFAS extract arrives, a forecast review is due, or management asks about financial performance.
steps: Review AFAS actuals, Power BI dashboards and the latest Excel forecast.
Ask the Controller and FP&A Analysts to explain unexpected movements.
Compare site results, cash balances, outstanding invoices and forecast assumptions.
Assess whether changes reflect timing, accounting errors or business performance.
Explain the outlook and recommend action to management.
drudgery: Reconciling different spreadsheet versions.
Repeating actual-versus-forecast comparisons.
Finding the source behind a dashboard number.
today.time_sinks: Waiting for explanations and reconciling data consume time before the director can judge the outlook; the actual split needs observation.

lenses.faster: Calculate cash movements, site variances and forecast bridges from one reconciled dataset. The director receives material exceptions with source links instead of rebuilding comparisons.
lenses.autonomous: After a successful nightly refresh, rules recalculate the outlook and flag missing data or threshold breaches. An approved language model drafts explanations from verified figures and recorded owner comments.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a weekly cash outlook and test site-level downside scenarios throughout the month. Compare previous forecasts with actuals to identify assumptions that repeatedly fail.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet reconciliation and repeated requests for figures. Keep the conversations about what is changing and what Noordhaven should do.
lenses.options: Compare base, lower-volume, higher-agency-cost, slower-customer-payment and combined-stress scenarios. Show which assumptions drive cash pressure and forecast uncertainty.
lenses.altitude: Design the financial monitoring system, its assumptions and escalation thresholds. Review whether it spots problems early enough and improves forecast accuracy.
reach: Review FP&A forecast assumptions more frequently.
Connect the Controller’s close exceptions to the financial outlook.
Assess the cash impact of collection priorities with the Credit and Collections Officer.

tasks.human_edge: The director judges whether operating explanations are credible, challenges optimistic assumptions and takes responsibility for recommendations to management.
tasks.pattern_why: Rules calculate the figures; an llm_step drafts source-linked commentary; the director approves the interpretation and resulting recommendation.

in_practice.trigger: Successful nightly refresh or an approved change to a forecast assumption.
steps: Retrieve authorised AFAS extracts, bank balances and the approved forecast version.
Check refresh timestamps, ledger control totals and site mappings; stop publication when checks fail.
Calculate variances, cash projections and scenarios using versioned formulas.
Draft an exception briefing that separates recorded explanations from hypotheses.
Route material issues to their owners and present the briefing for director approval.
in_practice.human_gate: The director approves material explanations, changed assumptions and management recommendations; ordinary calculations run automatically.
data_needed: General ledger, receivables, payables and site mappings.
Bank balances and committed financing.
Approved forecast assumptions and historical forecast versions.
Approved operational volume and capacity exports; their source system is not specified.
Owner explanations with dates and supporting records.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint financial-analysis register containing source timestamps, checks, assumption versions, drafts and approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors support retrieval of administrator-defined records and fields.
Power BI supports scheduled refresh, providing a basis for repeatable financial monitoring.
The proposed briefing workflow is plausible, but 60% human-time saving and 2.2-times elapsed speed are unmeasured planning estimates.

risks: Nightly data may omit intraday cash movements; each briefing needs an explicit as-of time.
AFAS financial records alone cannot explain warehouse or transport productivity.
Generated commentary may present correlation or an unverified explanation as fact.
Forecast improvement depends on better assumptions and owner action, not report production alone.
research_questions: Can six months of historical forecasts and actuals be reconciled by site using stable account mappings?
Which operational exports explain the largest revenue and labour-cost movements?
Does a parallel trial reduce director preparation time while maintaining the quality of management decisions?
Can material forecast errors be traced to specific assumptions and accountable owners?

tasks.short: Review financing applications and supporting figures when Noordhaven needs borrowing or lease funding.

today.trigger: Conditional assumed workflow: Noordhaven requests or renews financing; daily processing of customer loan applications is not established.
steps: Clarify the funding need and obtain the lender’s application requirements.
Collect accounts, cash forecasts, existing debt and supporting documents.
Review repayment capacity, covenant definitions, security and proposed terms.
Resolve questions with the Controller, management and lender.
Approve the application pack and seek the required borrowing authorisation.
drudgery: Re-entering the same financial figures in lender templates.
Checking document completeness.
Comparing differently formatted term sheets.
today.time_sinks: Lender questions, negotiations and approval calendars may dominate elapsed time. The supplied daily frequency and 136.9 annual hours are not validated for this logistics company.

lenses.faster: Populate lender templates from approved financial records and check required documents automatically. Extract proposed terms into a comparison table for director review.
lenses.autonomous: An approaching renewal or approved funding request starts a document checklist and draft application. Borrowing commitments remain subject to the company’s authorisation rules.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a financing-readiness pack and test repayment capacity before seasonal cash pressure appears. Pursue this only if borrowing activity is material enough to justify the setup.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated form filling and document chasing. Keep lender relationships, negotiation and decisions about financial flexibility.
lenses.options: Compare borrowing amounts, maturities, repayment profiles, security and covenant headroom. Label quotations and hypothetical terms separately.
lenses.altitude: Set financing policy, readiness standards and covenant-monitoring rules. Review exceptions and negotiate the terms that matter.
reach: Take on structured treasury preparation with the Controller.
Review FP&A funding scenarios.
Coordinate financing documentation for major operational investments.

tasks.human_edge: The director negotiates, judges the business consequences of security and covenants, and accepts responsibility for financing recommendations.
tasks.pattern_why: Document collection, term extraction and calculations can be combined into a checked application workflow; the director approves submissions and financing commitments.

in_practice.trigger: An authorised financing request or a renewal date in the financing register.
steps: Create a checklist from the lender’s requirements and retrieve approved supporting records.
Extract terms and covenant definitions with references to their source clauses.
Calculate repayment scenarios and covenant headroom using reviewed formulas.
Prepare the application and highlight missing documents, ambiguous clauses and adverse scenarios.
Obtain director approval before submission and record the lender’s response.
in_practice.human_gate: The director validates financial representations and extracted terms before submission; authorised signatories approve any commitment.
data_needed: Actual financing activity and delegated borrowing authorities.
Approved accounts, cash forecasts and existing debt schedules.
Lender application templates and current term sheets.
Contractual covenant definitions, security requirements and renewal dates.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint financing register linking source documents, extracted terms, calculation versions, submissions and approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS exposes authorised financial records through configured GetConnectors.
A language model can plausibly draft application text and extract terms for checking against source documents.
The workflow and its 50% human-time saving and 1.2-times elapsed speed are conditional on a real financing workload.

risks: This O*NET task may belong to a lending business and may contribute little actual work at Noordhaven.
Incorrect covenant interpretation or omitted security terms could materially change the financing decision.
Bank review and negotiation time remain outside Noordhaven’s automation.

If scope changes to assessing natural persons’ creditworthiness, assess the EU AI Act classification separately. [European Commission AI Act guidance](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act)
research_questions: Does the director actually process financing applications, and how many occurred in the last year?
How much time goes into document preparation compared with negotiation and lender waiting?
Can extracted covenant definitions and term comparisons pass review against previous agreements?
Would a maintained financing pack cost less than preparing the few applications that occur?

tasks.short: Review overdue customer balances and decide which collection problems need my intervention.

today.trigger: Assumed current workflow: the collections review is due or a large overdue customer balance is escalated.
steps: Open the AFAS receivables ageing report and Power BI collection dashboard.
Check receipts, credit notes, disputed invoices and payment promises.
Ask the Credit and Collections Officer about material overdue balances.
Prioritise director intervention using exposure, ageing and customer context.
Agree actions and monitor whether balances and days sales outstanding improve.
drudgery: Recalculating ageing totals.
Checking whether an overdue invoice has already been paid.
Reading long email chains to find the latest payment promise.
today.time_sinks: Matching receipts and assembling dispute histories delay the review; unresolved billing problems and customer behaviour determine collection outcomes.

lenses.faster: Reconcile open invoices with booked receipts and produce a ranked exception list. Summarise disputes and payment promises with links to the underlying correspondence.
lenses.autonomous: After the nightly refresh, rules update ageing and escalate broken promises or material overdue exposure. The director sees exceptions rather than checking every balance.
lenses.ambitious: Track the reasons invoices become overdue and identify recurring billing or service disputes. Use the findings to prevent late payment across all three sites.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated balance checks and email searching. Keep difficult customer conversations and decisions about commercial relationships.
lenses.options: Show the cash effect of settling disputes, enforcing agreed terms or arranging approved payment plans. Compare priorities without assuming every overdue customer poses the same risk.
lenses.altitude: Set collection escalation policy and review whether it reduces days sales outstanding. Improve the upstream processes that create disputes.
reach: Support the Credit and Collections Officer with exposure-based prioritisation.
Bring collection assumptions into FP&A cash forecasts.
Help operations and sales resolve recurring invoice disputes.

tasks.human_edge: The director balances cash recovery against customer relationships and makes sensitive decisions on concessions, legal escalation and service restrictions.
tasks.pattern_why: Ageing, exposure, payment-promise dates and escalation thresholds are checkable rules; an optional llm_step summarises correspondence for human checking.

in_practice.trigger: Successful nightly receivables refresh or an updated payment promise.
steps: Retrieve open invoices, booked receipts, credit notes and collection statuses.
Reconcile totals to the receivables control account and flag unmatched bank receipts.
Apply approved ageing, materiality and broken-promise rules.
Attach source-linked dispute summaries and route exceptions to the Collections Officer.
Escalate cases meeting director thresholds and record the agreed action.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine reporting runs without approval; the director approves material concessions, write-offs and sensitive escalations under delegated authority.
data_needed: Invoice dates, due dates, open amounts and customer terms.
Booked receipts, credit notes and unmatched bank transactions.
Payment promises, dispute statuses and authorised correspondence.
Materiality limits and collection escalation policy.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint collection-exception register linked to AFAS invoice identifiers, calculation timestamps, evidence and action owners.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors can retrieve configured records for an external ageing calculation.
Power BI supports threshold alerts on eligible dashboard tiles after data refresh.
A 75% saving in director review time and three-times review speed are planning estimates, not evidence of faster customer payment.

risks: Unbooked or unmatched receipts can create false overdue escalations.
Incorrect due dates or treatment of credit notes can distort ageing and days sales outstanding.
Customer correspondence may contain personal data and requires restricted access.
Faster reporting will not reduce days sales outstanding unless action owners resolve disputes and follow up.
research_questions: Can the automated ageing reconcile exactly to AFAS and identify unbooked receipts before escalation?
Are payment promises and dispute reasons recorded consistently enough to use?
What proportion of the director’s current review concerns routine balances rather than sensitive decisions?
Does a pilot reduce missed payment promises and overdue exposure as well as preparation time?

tasks.short: Prepare and approve Noordhaven’s board packs, financial statements and required financial submissions.

today.trigger: Assumed current workflow: a board meeting, statutory filing deadline or other confirmed reporting obligation approaches.
steps: Confirm the reporting requirements, timetable and responsible reviewers.
Collect reconciled balances, schedules and commentary from the finance team.
Transfer figures into Excel, Word and PowerPoint templates.
Review consistency, accounting judgements, disclosures and supporting evidence.
Approve the pack or submission through the required governance process.
drudgery: Copying figures between reports.
Checking that tables agree across documents.
Chasing reviewers and assembling audit evidence.
today.time_sinks: Late close adjustments, unresolved accounting judgements and review cycles can delay publication even when document preparation is automated.

lenses.faster: Populate approved report templates from a locked reporting dataset and run cross-document checks. Draft commentary from verified changes and approved accounting notes.
lenses.autonomous: The reporting calendar starts preparation when required reconciliations are complete. Missing evidence and failed checks create review tasks automatically.
lenses.ambitious: Make every material reported figure traceable to a reconciled balance and supporting schedule. Track recurring audit adjustments and remove their causes.
lenses.joy: Remove copying, formatting and repeated consistency checks. Keep the judgement about what the board needs to understand.
lenses.options: Generate alternative explanations of the same verified result for board discussion. Financial figures and statutory disclosures follow the approved reporting basis.
lenses.altitude: Own the reporting standards, evidence requirements and release controls. Improve the close process so reliable reports become ready sooner.
reach: Coordinate the Controller’s close and audit-evidence process.
Integrate FP&A forecast commentary into board reporting.
Coordinate aggregate financial information requested by the works council.

tasks.human_edge: The director owns material accounting judgements, clear disclosure and the credibility of the financial story; authorised officers retain responsibility for approval and filing.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic templates and checks prepare the report, while an llm_step drafts commentary; each external or board release requires human approval.

in_practice.trigger: Reporting milestone reached and the Controller marks the required close checks complete.
steps: Confirm the applicable obligation and retrieve the approved template and reporting snapshot.
Populate figures and supporting schedules from reconciled AFAS data.
Run ledger tie-outs, cross-report checks and required-field validation.
Draft source-linked commentary and list unresolved judgements or disclosures.
Obtain the required approvals, release through the authorised channel and retain the receipt.
in_practice.human_gate: The Controller checks reconciliations; the director approves material content; statutory adoption, signing and filing follow the company’s applicable requirements.
systems: Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint
data_needed: Reporting-obligation register and confirmed entity reporting requirements.
Locked trial balance, reconciliations and supporting schedules.
Approved report templates and accounting policies.
Material judgements, related disclosures and reviewer authorities.
Prior audit adjustments and filing receipts.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint reporting register containing dataset versions, checks, evidence links, reviewer decisions and filing receipts.

evidence.claim: Configured AFAS GetConnectors provide a documented way to retrieve records for report preparation.
Template population, reconciliation checks and source-linked drafting are plausible components of a controlled reporting workflow.
The proposed 60% human-time saving and 1.5-times elapsed speed require measurement across actual close and review cycles.

risks: A report can be internally consistent while containing an incorrect accounting treatment.
Noordhaven’s reporting size category and additional obligations cannot be established from employee count alone.

The reporting calendar must reflect applicable BV requirements, including filing within eight days of adoption. [KVK filing deadlines](https://www.kvk.nl/deponeren/uiterste-termijn-deponeren-jaarrekening/)
Uncontrolled changes to a reporting snapshot could invalidate previously approved figures.
research_questions: Which reports, filing formats and approval requirements actually apply to Noordhaven?
Can every material report line be traced to a reconciled balance and evidence schedule?
How much director time is spent preparing documents versus resolving judgements and reviewing them?
Does a trial reduce preparation time without increasing audit adjustments or reviewer corrections?

tasks.short: Improve finance systems, controls and procedures so the team closes faster and produces dependable forecasts.

today.trigger: Assumed current workflow: close delays, audit findings, invoice exceptions or forecast problems reveal a process weakness.
steps: Gather process evidence and speak with the finance team and affected site managers.
Trace how records and approvals move through AFAS, Excel and agency portals.
Evaluate control weaknesses, recurring exceptions and their business impact.
Compare changes to systems, responsibilities, procedures or budgets.
Agree a recommendation, implementation owner and measures of success.
drudgery: Reconstructing the same process from scattered records.
Manually classifying recurring exceptions.
Preparing similar improvement proposals.
today.time_sinks: Finding reliable process timestamps and understanding why staff use workarounds take longer than drafting recommendations.

lenses.faster: Summarise available workflow logs, recurring exceptions and staff feedback into a fact-based process review. Draft options and business cases from measured volumes and handling times.
lenses.autonomous: Monitor close delays, invoice exceptions and failed controls against agreed thresholds. Create an improvement brief when a pattern repeats, with the director deciding whether to act.
lenses.ambitious: Run small, measured improvements across procure to pay, order to cash, record to report and plan to forecast. Judge success by finance outcomes rather than the number of automations installed.
lenses.joy: Remove process reconstruction and repetitive proposal writing. Keep problem solving with the team and helping sites work better.
lenses.options: Compare a rules change, data-quality fix, clearer ownership, targeted automation and a larger system change. Show cost, control effects and operating effort for each.
lenses.altitude: Manage the finance operating system: standards, controls, ownership and improvement priorities. Use measured results to retire weak procedures.
reach: Lead cross-site process improvement with operations.
Coordinate finance data definitions with the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
Support agency invoice controls with Payroll and HR.

tasks.human_edge: The director understands incentives and workarounds, chooses acceptable control trade-offs and secures cooperation from people whose work will change.
tasks.pattern_why: Evidence gathering and option drafting can accelerate the review, but selecting and implementing a process change requires organisational judgement and negotiation.

in_practice.trigger: A recurring control failure, deteriorating input metric or scheduled process review.
steps: Gather authorised process logs, exception samples and staff explanations.
Measure the baseline and distinguish observed bottlenecks from hypotheses.
Draft alternative changes with costs, control implications and responsible owners.
Have the director and process owners select a limited trial with success criteria.
Review trial results and approve adoption, revision or withdrawal.
in_practice.human_gate: The director selects the intervention; process owners validate it; changes to permissions and financial controls receive the required independent review.
data_needed: Workflow timestamps, exception reasons and transaction volumes.
Current approval authorities and segregation-of-duties rules.
Close duration, forecast errors, invoice touch rates and audit adjustments.
Observed handling times and staff feedback.
Implementation costs and operational dependencies.
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint improvement register recording baseline evidence, options, decisions, trial results and control changes.

evidence.claim: AFAS permits integrations through authorised GetConnectors and UpdateConnectors; exposed fields and operations require configuration.
An assistant can plausibly organise process evidence and draft alternatives, while causal diagnosis still needs staff validation.
The proposed 35% human-time saving and 1.4-times elapsed speed are unmeasured estimates for analysis and recommendation work.

risks: Faster approval flows may weaken segregation of duties or hide exceptions.
Available logs may omit manual work, making the wrong activity appear to be the bottleneck.
Changes to employee-data arrangements or monitoring may require OR consent. [SER employee privacy guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/belangrijke-themas/privacy)
Removing manual work can shift effort into exception handling and system maintenance.
research_questions: Which process failure currently contributes most to close delays or unreliable forecasts?
Do system logs capture the manual work and waiting time identified by staff?
Can a limited trial improve the selected metric without weakening a control?
Who will own the rules, exception queue and maintenance after implementation?

tasks.short: Prepare site performance and financial risk reports that tell management where action is needed.

today.trigger: Assumed current workflow: a management review is due or a significant operational or financial risk emerges.
steps: Collect site financial results and available operational measures.
Gather aggregate labour costs, agency spending and relevant risk-owner updates.
Compare results with plans and identify material exposures.
Prepare charts and explanations in Excel or PowerPoint.
Discuss the report with management and assign actions.
systems: Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint
drudgery: Combining differently formatted site updates.
Refreshing the same charts.
Chasing risk owners for status notes.
today.time_sinks: Operational data sources and definitions are not specified; reliable reports depend on resolving those gaps before automating presentation.

lenses.faster: Combine verified site measures and owner updates in a standard report. Calculate changes automatically and draft commentary only for material exceptions.
lenses.autonomous: A successful refresh updates agreed risk measures and routes threshold breaches to owners. A management pack is prepared when required owner updates are complete.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain an early-warning view of cash, customer concentration, agency-cost exposure and site cost pressure. Track whether management actions actually reduce the exposure.
lenses.joy: Remove chart refreshing and status chasing. Keep discussion of risks that need a decision.
lenses.options: Show separate and combined scenarios for lower volumes, higher agency costs and delayed receipts. Make the affected site and action owner visible.
lenses.altitude: Define risk measures, escalation thresholds and response ownership. Review whether the system warns early enough without overwhelming managers.
reach: Combine FP&A financial risk analysis with site management reviews.
Coordinate aggregate workforce-cost risks with HR.
Support the Controller’s reporting of unresolved close and control risks.

tasks.human_edge: The director decides which risks matter, challenges weak owner explanations and makes sure management takes action rather than merely receiving reports.
tasks.pattern_why: Rules calculate risk indicators and an llm_step summarises owner updates; the director approves interpretation and the management action pack.

in_practice.trigger: Successful reporting refresh, a material threshold breach or the management reporting deadline.
steps: Collect reconciled financial measures, approved site exports and aggregate workforce-cost data.
Check completeness, reporting dates and agreed definitions across the three sites.
Calculate risk indicators and scenario effects using approved rules.
Draft an exception pack with source links, owners and overdue actions.
Have the director approve the pack and record management decisions.
in_practice.human_gate: The director approves material risk assessments and recommended actions; operational and HR owners validate statements in their areas.
data_needed: Site financial results and approved operational measures.
Aggregate payroll, overtime and agency spending.
Customer concentration, overdue exposure and cash forecasts.
Risk thresholds, owner updates and action statuses.
Aggregate certificate-compliance status from Studytube only if relevant and authorised.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint risk register linking report snapshots, indicator definitions, owner evidence, approvals and management actions.

evidence.claim: Power BI can issue threshold alerts on eligible dashboard tiles using refreshed data.
Combining checked indicators with source-linked owner summaries is a plausible reporting workflow.
The proposed 70% human-time saving and three-times elapsed speed depend on obtaining consistent site and owner inputs.

risks: Incomplete operations data could produce a polished report with weak explanations.
Too many thresholds can create an exception queue that managers ignore.

Use aggregate absence-cost information for financial analysis; medical details belong outside this workflow. [AP guidance for employers](https://autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/themas/werk-en-uitkering/zieke-werknemers/regels-voor-werkgevers-bij-zieke-werknemers)

Employee-level performance evaluation or allocation using AI would require a separate EU AI Act assessment. [European Commission AI Act guidance](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act)
research_questions: Which operational measures have consistent definitions and reliable exports across all three sites?
Which current report sections regularly lead to a management decision?
Can risk thresholds detect known past problems without generating excessive false alarms?
Can workforce-cost reporting remain useful with aggregate data and no medical details?

tasks.short: Review labour, agency and operating costs to set realistic site budgets.

today.trigger: Assumed current workflow: the annual budget, a forecast update or a material cost change requires review.
steps: Review AFAS cost history, payroll totals and agency spending by site.
Obtain expected volumes, staffing needs and supplier changes from budget owners.
Check labour assumptions with Payroll and HR against the applicable CAOs.
Compare proposed costs with actuals and build alternative budgets in Excel.
Challenge assumptions and agree the budget recommendation with management.
drudgery: Cleaning agency files and matching cost categories.
Recalculating labour-cost assumptions across spreadsheet versions.
Comparing budget submissions with prior actuals.
today.time_sinks: Unclear volume assumptions, different cost mappings and late site submissions limit how quickly a credible budget can be agreed.

lenses.faster: Calculate baseline costs and scenario changes from mapped actuals and approved rates. Draft explanations of the largest budget movements for the director to challenge.
lenses.autonomous: Approved changes to volumes, agency rates or CAO assumptions recalculate draft budgets and flag material differences. Owners approve assumptions before they enter the official forecast.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain cost-driver models for each site instead of relying mainly on last year plus a percentage. Test seasonal staffing and capacity choices against expected demand.
lenses.joy: Remove rate copying and spreadsheet repair. Keep the discussion about the resources each site needs and the costs it can control.
lenses.options: Compare volume levels, flex-worker mixes, overtime and investment alternatives. Respect both CAOs and operational constraints in every scenario.
lenses.altitude: Set the budget model, assumption standards and challenge process. Track which cost drivers explain actual performance and improve them over time.
reach: Deepen FP&A cost modelling and scenario review.
Assess workforce-cost assumptions jointly with HR and Payroll.
Support operations with financial evaluation of staffing and capacity plans.

tasks.human_edge: The director challenges whether cost reductions are operationally credible, protects required service capacity and negotiates a budget that managers will own.
tasks.pattern_why: A deterministic cost model produces scenarios; an llm_step drafts explanations; the director and relevant owners approve assumptions and budget commitments.

in_practice.trigger: Budget cycle starts or an authorised cost-driver assumption changes.
steps: Load mapped cost actuals, agency charges and approved payroll assumptions.
Validate site allocations, rate effective dates and forecast input completeness.
Calculate site budgets and scenarios with versioned cost-driver formulas.
Draft variance explanations and highlight unsupported or conflicting assumptions.
Route assumptions to HR, Payroll and site owners, then obtain director approval of the recommendation.
in_practice.human_gate: HR and Payroll validate CAO-derived assumptions; site owners validate operating needs; the director approves the financial recommendation.
data_needed: Site cost history, account mappings and allocation rules.
Approved volumes, capacity plans and staffing assumptions.
Validated wage rates, allowances, employer charges and CAO effective dates.
Agency rate cards, hours, commitments and invoices.
Approved aggregate absence and replacement-cost assumptions.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint budget register containing input sources, rate versions, scenario results, owner validations and approval history.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports retrieval of configured records through authorised GetConnectors.
Versioned rules can calculate labour and operating-cost scenarios when rates, allocations and volume assumptions are explicit.
The proposed 55% human-time saving and 1.7-times elapsed speed are unmeasured estimates for budget analysis and approval.

risks: Applying the wrong CAO, allowance rule or effective date can understate labour costs.
Agency invoices may mix rates, surcharges and periods that require explicit mapping.
Financial scenarios must include applicable absence and reintegration costs; HR retains Wet verbetering poortwachter case management.

A budget scenario does not authorise changes to employee arrangements; applicable OR rights need separate review. [SER consent-right guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/aan-de-slag-met-de-or/rechten/instemmingsrecht)
research_questions: Can Payroll and HR supply validated cost assumptions for both CAOs with effective dates?
Can all three agency exports be mapped to comparable hours, rates and surcharges?
Which operational drivers explain historical site cost changes better than a flat percentage uplift?
Does a parallel budget cycle reduce preparation effort without increasing forecast error?

tasks.short: Review securities prices and transactions if Noordhaven actually holds a treasury investment portfolio.

today.trigger: Unconfirmed workflow: a treasury review or securities transaction would trigger analysis; no securities holdings are specified.
steps: Confirm whether Noordhaven holds securities and identify the responsible owner.
If applicable, retrieve transaction statements and dated market prices.
Reconcile holdings, income and realised or unrealised movements.
Assess liquidity, concentration and compliance with treasury policy.
Recommend action within approved investment authorities.
systems: Rabobank securities statements only if such an account exists
drudgery: If a portfolio exists, copying prices and reconciling statements.
Searching dated market commentary.
Checking holdings against policy limits.
today.time_sinks: The first issue is task applicability. Do not treat the supplied 50.4 hours as actual Noordhaven work without confirming holdings and review activity.

lenses.faster: If holdings exist, reconcile statements and calculate policy exposure using approved dated prices. Otherwise remove this task from the company-specific role assessment.
lenses.autonomous: A statement arrival could trigger reconciliation and policy-limit checks after the data source is confirmed. Trading remains subject to approved authorities.
lenses.ambitious: If relevant, maintain a clear view of treasury liquidity and concentration. Confirm the business need before building market-analysis automation.
lenses.joy: Remove price copying and statement checking where these occur. Keep decisions about liquidity, risk and capital preservation.
lenses.options: For an existing portfolio, compare approved liquidity and exposure scenarios using explicit assumptions. Do not turn generated market narratives into investment recommendations.
lenses.altitude: Define treasury monitoring standards and review exceptions against policy. Establish whether this work belongs in the director’s role at all.
reach: Support the Controller’s reconciliation of existing treasury holdings.
Connect confirmed investment liquidity to FP&A cash forecasts.
Coordinate treasury-policy reporting if the board requires it.

tasks.human_edge: The director determines whether investments fit Noordhaven’s liquidity needs and risk appetite and accepts responsibility for any recommendation.
tasks.pattern_why: If a portfolio exists, holdings reconciliation and policy-limit checks have structured inputs and checkable outputs; investment decisions remain human.

in_practice.trigger: After applicability is confirmed, receipt of an authorised securities statement or approved price update.
steps: Confirm holdings, account ownership, treasury policy and data access.
Retrieve transaction statements and approved timestamped prices.
Reconcile positions and calculate valuation and policy exposures.
Flag missing prices, unexplained differences and policy breaches.
Present exceptions for director review and retain the resulting decision.
in_practice.human_gate: The director approves investment recommendations and policy changes; authorised signatories approve trades through existing controls.
data_needed: Evidence that securities holdings and transaction reviews exist.
Holdings, identifiers, transactions, income and fees.
Approved price source, currency rates and valuation dates.
Treasury policy, liquidity requirements and investment authorities.
in_practice.logs_to: If applicable, a restricted SharePoint treasury register containing statement references, price timestamps, reconciliations, exceptions and decisions.

evidence.claim: Holdings reconciliation, dated valuation and policy-limit checks are plausible deterministic calculations once inputs are available.
No evidence supplied establishes a securities portfolio or applicable review workload; no saving is credited.

risks: Building this workflow could spend effort on an O*NET task Noordhaven does not perform.
Stale prices, incorrect identifiers or currency treatment can misstate exposure.
Generated market commentary may contain unsupported claims.
Transaction authority and reconciliation responsibility must remain appropriately separated.
research_questions: Does Noordhaven hold securities, or only cash and ordinary bank deposits?
Who reviews any holdings, how often, and with what measured effort?
Are authorised statements and suitable dated prices available in a usable format?
Would rules-based reconciliation solve a material problem beyond existing bank reporting?

role.altitude: The Finance Director becomes the owner of a finance system that produces reconciled figures, explicit forecasts and timely exceptions, while leading financial decisions and business challenge.
reach: Take a more active role in FP&A scenario design and forecast challenge.
Connect the Controller’s close controls and audit findings to improvement priorities.
Support collections policy and major customer interventions.
Jointly assess workforce-cost plans with HR, Payroll and site management.
Lead financial evaluation of site capacity and operational investments.
Coordinate treasury readiness where an actual financing workload exists.
role.ceiling_note: The supplied tasks total 685.7 hours, about 43% of the roughly 1,600-hour role implied by the shares. Current workflows and anatomy percentages are inferred, not observed. Savings percentages estimate recurring director labour; speedup estimates task elapsed time, including remaining review and waiting. Excluding unconfirmed loan and securities work, the estimates imply about 298 gross hours of annual capacity, valued at roughly EUR 35,800 at EUR 120/hour. This is not a cash saving or a validated total: overlapping work, setup, maintenance and exception handling can reduce it. Faster packs shorten month close only when they remove work on the critical path. Accountability, negotiation, trust and decisions under uncertainty remain substantial limits.
skills_to_grow: Define financial data contracts, mappings and reconciliation checks.
